levels.released: Versioned, reproducible distribution with explicit support boundaries.
levels.validated: Measured on a defined build and hardware configuration with evidence.
levels.qualifying: Implemented and tested or compile-verified, with target evidence still being gathered.
levels.implemented: Code path, data model, command, or provider boundary exists.
levels.planned: Architecture or accepted design exists; end-to-end implementation is incomplete.

capabilities.label: Apple Silicon / Metal
capabilities.summary: Primary public local execution and validation path.
limitations: Support is bounded by selected build, model, hardware, and receipt gates.

capabilities.label: Portable CPU
capabilities.summary: Reference, fallback, differential validation, and Linux hardening path.
limitations: Performance and model coverage remain build-specific.

capabilities.label: MI300X / ROCm-HIP
capabilities.summary: Active AMD CDNA GPU compilation and execution validation surface.
limitations: Validation does not imply universal ROCm GPU support.

capabilities.label: XDNA / XDNA2
capabilities.summary: Compile-verified spatial planning, resource legality, artifacts, and runtime boundaries.
limitations: General Ryzen AI hardware execution awaits matching device and userspace validation.

capabilities.label: Apple Neural Engine / Core ML
capabilities.summary: MIL construction, packaging, compilation, arena, stateful request, and dispatch boundaries.

capabilities.label: CUDA
capabilities.summary: PTX compilation, launch validation, buffer binding, dispatch, and timing-evidence surfaces.
limitations: Implemented integration boundary is not a released universal NVIDIA backend.

capabilities.label: ComputeImage
capabilities.summary: Versioned deployment artifact carrying logical tensors, physical layouts, execution views, plans, payloads, and evidence.
limitations: Artifact and backend ABI contracts remain pre-1.0.

capabilities.label: Constitutional ECS
capabilities.summary: Transactional canonical state, durable events, replay, stale-outcome rejection, and rebuildable projections.
limitations: Several domains remain in shadow or staged authority migration.

capabilities.label: Replay and evidence operations
capabilities.summary: Receipt preservation, replay bundles, experiment comparison, regression detection, and baseline promotion surfaces.
limitations: Individual evidence classes remain scoped to their producing build and fixture.

capabilities.label: Multimodal image pipeline
capabilities.summary: Image ingestion, dynamic tiling, vision encoders, projectors, image-token strategy, and multimodal composition.
limitations: Requires separate end-to-end model and target qualification.

capabilities.label: Audio and speech pipeline
capabilities.summary: Streaming state, resampling, residual vector quantization, temporal attention, codecs, and generation receipts.
limitations: Not presented as a finished universal speech product workflow.

capabilities.label: Resumable ternary distill compiler
capabilities.summary: Accepted architecture for an overnight resumable, evidence-preserving ternary compilation workflow.
